name: Whale / informed-flow tracking, fast-follow and follower-flow trades
one_line: Detect the on-chain fingerprint of informed money (fresh wallet, one family, conviction size at a low price, common funder) within seconds and follow it, pull quotes against it, or sell the alert; detection is validated, profitable following is not.
maturity: Emerging for the detect-and-react build (screens validated on prosecuted cases; no documented follower PnL; the one practitioner failed); the insider practice itself is file 30
requires_ai: optional; LLM only offline for market-family and information-source tagging
edge: Public pseudonymous tape exposes informed size; strongest as a maker quote-pull trigger
capital: <$1k detector / quote-pull; $1k-$10k following, depth-capped clips locked to the event
build_time: 2-4 weeks solo on an existing maker stack
opportunity_size: Informed pool ~$143M/2 yr; followers get post-sweep depth of $0.5-3k per alert; shrinking
expected_results: no public data for followers; guess -3% to +4%/month on following capital before fixed costs, fat tails; quote-pull worth $100-500/month on a $10k book
competition: Alert vendors, ForesightFlow papers, Reddit detectors, seconds-fast whale-feed bots
flag: grey; front-running own followers and baiting prohibited (ToS 4.2, US 7.2(j))
validate: Replay three screens on the archive; precision by category, follower PnL at post-alert touch; >=300 alerts
top_risk: False positives dominate; you buy the post-sweep price and become exit liquidity
solo_fit_reason: Cheap, free data, and the detector immediately protects the owner's maker and copy bots; as a standalone follower it has no documented PnL, thin post-sweep depth and legal grey areas, so it earns its place as shared infrastructure rather than as income.
speed_class: latency-sensitive: 1-3 s from match decides whether you follow or are followed
results_1k: detector / quote-pull yes; following marginal, -$70 to +$50/month (guess)
results_10k: -$400 to +$850/month incl. $100-500 of avoided maker losses (derived guess)
min_capital: ~$0 as a defence; ~$3k to follow so one clip is not a third of the book
capacity_ceiling: ~$10-20k following capital; low thousands of dollars of depth per true alert
services: Polygon RPC / log indexer (Alchemy, Goldsky, Envio HyperSync)
historical archive (Hugging Face Polymarket-v1, poly_data, polyledger)
alert products as benchmark (PolyTrack, Presage, Polysights)
changes_made: Written 2026-09-28 with live checks: Data API large-fill tape (1,500 taker fills >= $2k in 8.9 h, 544 wallets, Orca-rule screen, wallet-age lookups), CLOB price paths and books after the 12 largest flagged non-sports fills, Gamma tag census (geopolitics 372 of 437 markets fee-free, no taker-delay keys), builder-attributed fills for MetaMask / PolyCop / Kreo / betmoar and a copy-cascade test on 900 PolyCop and 900 Kreo fills.

Critic notes addressed: maturity split from file 30 (Emerging for detection, Established practice for the illegal act); builder-code labelling, thin-book front-running and selling into followers folded in as flow-side hazards and flagged.

Established that the public Data API `/trades` rows carry no builder field; app labels come only from `/builder/trades` per code or the on-chain `OrderFilled` `builder` field (docs fees.md), and the `builder` string in `/builder/trades` rows is empty while `builderCode` is populated.

Re-fetched every load-bearing source: Nechepurenko 2605.02287 is now v2 (2026-08-24) and still does not test following; Mitts & Ofir figures confirmed; Al-Monitor Orca definition and copycat wagers confirmed; PolyTrack pricing and disclaimer confirmed; Presage and Polysights are marketing with no results.

Cite-check + skeptic pass 2026-09-28 (25 sources re-fetched or re-queried, 22 confirmed as written, 5 corrected, 0 removed, 0 unreachable): the lifecycle heuristic and its 1,950 / $15,012.92 / t = 8.65 figures re-attributed to Gomez-Cram, Guo, Jensen and Kung (SSRN, April 2026) as reported by Nechepurenko [1], whose v2 is listed by arXiv as revised 2026-05-14 (the body says August 24) and whose sample is 2023-2025; the '3% of traders drive price discovery' line re-attributed to the same study's 3.14% skilled-winner figure instead of WSJ; HN source corrected to the hx8 comment id 48008935 and its follow-up quote on why following gave 'not a very big edge' added; The Oracle interviewee corrected to Ridgely, co-founder of Stand; the Stand 'few seconds' quote put in its tariff-news context (public-news takers, not insiders); Data API caps corrected from '500 / 1,000' to the honoured values measured live; `seconds_delay: 0` added from CLOB /markets as the direct no-delay evidence; geopolitics census scope stated (top 100 events; 765 of 983 markets fee-free across 300 events); Polysights counters and builder-trades stats re-run; investment-size rows tightened to -3% to +4% gross per month at $5k so the table and Expected results agree.
open_doubts: No follower PnL exists anywhere in public; the -3% to +4%/month range and the $100-500/month quote-pull value are guesses.
Today's tape (one Monday, 8.9 h) had zero fresh Orca-rule wallets outside sports and crypto; the precision of the screens on a longer window was not measured here.
The Gomez-Cram et al. SSRN paper (lifecycle heuristic, 3.14% skilled, 7-12x price impact per dollar) is known only through Nechepurenko [1] and press coverage in E4, not fetched directly.
Copy-cascade test used 45 fills per bot over a two-hour evening window dominated by live sports; cascades behind large geopolitics fills may be stronger.
Whether knowingly following suspected classified-information leakage creates liability for the follower is untested in any case.
Goldsky and Envio prices are vendor pages; the practical cost of a sub-3 s OrderFilled subscription at Polymarket's fill rate was not measured.
Builder leaderboard volumes moved 5-20% between 20:03 and 20:50 UTC, so its window or lag is unclear; the file quotes the 20:03 snapshot.
